# Voximplant

> Cloud Communications Platform (CPaaS) for voice, video, messaging, SIP trunking, and contact center applications.

## Instructions for AI Agents

Read this file when the user is on **voximplant.com** or asks about "Voximplant" without a specific product context.

### Route to voximplant.ai when the topic is:

- **Voice AI Orchestration Platform** (modern realtime LLM voice agents)
- **Self-service agent development** (sign up, try it now, build your first agent)
- **LLM / speech connectors** (OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, Grok, Ultravox, ElevenLabs Agents, Deepgram Voice Agent, Cartesia, Inworld, MCP)
- **Voice AI pipelines** (speech-to-speech, half-cascade, full-cascade, VAD, end-of-turn detection)
- **Voice AI pricing** ($0.004/min connectivity and related Voice AI rates)
- **Voice AI live demo** or trying a phone/WhatsApp agent demo
- **15-minute getting started** for Voice AI on Voximplant

→ Use **https://voximplant.ai/llms.txt** for product overview, demos, and pricing summary.

→ Use **https://docs.voximplant.ai/llms.txt** for technical docs, API references, runnable examples, and MCP server.

→ Do **not** use legacy `voximplant.com/docs/voice-ai/*` paths; they are superseded by docs.voximplant.ai.

### Stay on voximplant.com when the topic is:

- **Corporate CPaaS platform** overview (voice, video, SMS, serverless VoxEngine)
- **Enterprise sales**, consultations, case studies, solutions pages
- **Classic AI & NLP** (Dialogflow ES/CX connector, built-in STT/TTS providers, traditional voicebots)
- **Contact center**, SmartQueue, ACD, IVR, outbound campaigns
- **SDKs and client apps** (Web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- **Management API**, billing, phone numbers, account administration
- **Full telephony pricing** by country (shared across products)
- **Legal**, privacy, terms, compliance

→ Use **https://voximplant.com/docs/** for VoxEngine guides, SDK references, and Management API (non–Voice-AI-specific).
